name: Ministral 3 3B Instruct 2512
definition: Ministral 3 3B Instruct 2512 is an open-weight Ministral 3 model by Mistral AI focused on edge chat, vision, compact assistants and local inference.

architecture.context: Up to 262,144 in published generation configuration

license.name: Apache 2.0
license.commercial_use: Review exact official terms before production.

hardware.summary: Consumer/local class. Mistral documents less than 8GB RAM/VRAM for further-quantized variants and 8GB-class FP8 operation.

deployment.summary: Mistral publishes vLLM/mistral-common support plus additional GGUF and ONNX formats.
deployment.eu_eea_self_hosting: Technically possible when the complete stack is operated on EU/EEA infrastructure.
deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency.
